name: DecayCard-TS-TW

frames.best_why: The photo is tilted with its edges chewed into ragged noise, showing the decay effect at full strength.

tagline: A photo card crumbles at the edges as the cursor moves fast.
summary: A framed greyscale portrait tilts with the pointer while a noise filter tears away its edges when the cursor moves quickly. Large white words sit across the lower left of the image.
appearance: A tall greyscale photo of a pug wrapped in a blanket, with heavy white display words reading 'Decay Card' across its lower left. A short caption sits on the dark stage below.
behaviour: The whole card drifts and tilts slightly with the pointer, and fast movement ramps up a noise distortion that gnaws the image edges into rough shapes. When the cursor slows, the edges settle back toward a rectangle.
demo_content: Greyscale pug-in-a-blanket photo, overlay words 'Decay Card', caption 'Move the cursor quickly to distort the image.'
search_phrases: photo card that tears apart on hover
card with big words over a photo
grayscale photo card with overlay text
use_when: A hero card or editorial feature needs a tactile, slightly unsettling image interaction.
avoid_when: It listens to the whole window and runs a constant loop, so unrelated mouse motion distorts the card.
customise: Image URL, width, height, noise frequency, octaves, seed, maximum displacement and movement bound are props; the overlay words come in as children.
weight_why: A permanent requestAnimationFrame loop drives an SVG displacement filter over a full-size photo.

a11y.note: The photo has no alt text and a permanent animation loop that ignores reduced-motion settings.

issues: The overlay words spill past the right edge of the photo onto the dark stage.
Movement anywhere in the window distorts the card, not only movement over it.
polish_why: A memorable distortion on a striking photo; the oversized words overflow the card edge.
title: DecayCard
